movies.title: Interstellar
movies.description: A team of explorers travels beyond this galaxy to discover whether mankind has a future among the stars.

movies.title: Project Hail Mary
movies.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up alone aboard a spaceship light-years from Earth with no memory of how he got there. As his memories return, he discovers his mission is to save humanity from an extinction-level threat. Along the way, he encounters an unexpected ally.

movies.title: War Machine
movies.description: During the final stage of Army Ranger selection, an elite team of recruits finds their training exercise turned into a fight for survival against an unimaginable otherworldly threat.

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus, king of Ithaca, embarks on a dangerous journey home. Along the way, he faces mythical creatures, treacherous obstacles, and extraordinary challenges as he fights to reunite with his family.

movies.title: Tetris
movies.description: In 1988, video game entrepreneur Henk Rogers discovers Tetris and travels to the Soviet Union to secure the rights to the game. As he navigates political tensions, complicated negotiations, and corporate competition, he risks everything to bring Tetris to the world.

movies.title: How to Train Your Dragon
movies.description: On the island of Berk, a young Viking named Hiccup challenges tradition when he befriends Toothless, a powerful Night Fury dragon. Their friendship could change the relationship between Vikings and dragons forever.

movies.title: The Truman Show
movies.description: Truman Burbank lives an ordinary life in a seemingly perfect seaside town. However, he slowly begins to discover that his entire world may be an elaborate television production and that everyone around him is hiding something.

movies.title: Whiplash
movies.description: Andrew Neyman is an ambitious young drummer determined to become one of the greatest musicians of his generation. His dedication is tested when he encounters Terence Fletcher, a demanding instructor whose teaching methods push him to his limits.

movies.title: The Hunger Games
movies.description: In a dystopian future, Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her younger sister's place in the Hunger Games, a televised competition where young contestants are forced to fight for survival.

movies.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
movies.description: After surviving the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta return home as symbols of rebellion. As unrest spreads throughout Panem, President Snow announces a special Quarter Quell that forces them back into the arena.

movies.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
movies.description: After the destruction of the arena, Katniss finds herself in District 13. As the rebellion against the Capitol grows, she becomes the face of the revolution while fighting to save those she loves.

movies.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
movies.description: Katniss and her closest allies leave District 13 for a dangerous mission through the Capitol. As the rebellion reaches its final stage, Katniss must confront President Snow and decide what kind of future Panem deserves.

movies.title: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
movies.description: Decades before Katniss Everdeen, a young Coriolanus Snow is assigned to mentor Lucy Gray Baird during the 10th Hunger Games. As their relationship develops, Snow faces choices that will shape the future of Panem.

movies.title: Planet of the Apes
movies.description: An astronaut crew crash-lands on a mysterious planet ruled by intelligent apes. Captain George Taylor discovers that humans are treated as primitive creatures and uncovers a shocking secret about the planet.

movies.title: Beneath the Planet of the Apes
movies.description: Another astronaut arrives on the mysterious planet searching for Taylor. His journey leads him underground, where he discovers a hidden civilization of mutant humans who worship a devastating weapon.

movies.title: Escape from the Planet of the Apes
movies.description: Cornelius and Zira escape the destruction of their world and travel back in time to 20th-century Earth. Initially welcomed as celebrities, they soon become targets when humans discover their origins and what the future holds.

movies.title: Conquest of the Planet of the Apes
movies.description: In a future where apes have become enslaved servants, Caesar, the son of Cornelius and Zira, rises against humanity and leads a revolution that will change the future of the planet.

movies.title: Battle for the Planet of the Apes
movies.description: Years after the ape revolution, Caesar attempts to build a peaceful society where humans and apes can coexist. However, growing tensions and a power-hungry ape threaten the future of their civilization.

movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movies.description: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

movies.title: The Angry Birds Movie
movies.description: Red, a short-tempered bird, teams up with Chuck and Bomb to investigate the mysterious arrival of green pigs on their peaceful island.

movies.title: A Minecraft Movie
movies.description: Four misfits are transported into the Overworld, a strange cubic world where they must team up with Steve to survive and find their way home.

movies.title: Planet of the Apes
movies.description: Astronaut Leo Davidson crash-lands on a mysterious planet where intelligent apes rule over humans. With the help of an ape named Ari, he attempts to escape their civilization.

movies.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
movies.description: A scientist develops a treatment for Alzheimer's that dramatically increases the intelligence of chimpanzees. One chimpanzee named Caesar begins to develop extraordinary abilities and eventually leads an uprising.

movies.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
movies.description: Ten years after a devastating virus, Caesar leads a growing community of intelligent apes. When a group of human survivors enters their territory, a fragile peace threatens to collapse.

movies.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
movies.description: Caesar and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with a ruthless human military leader. As the war escalates, Caesar struggles with his darkest instincts while fighting for the future of his people.

movies.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
movies.description: Generations after Caesar's reign, a young ape named Noa embarks on a journey that challenges everything he knows about the past and the future of apes and humans.

movies.title: Magazine Dreams
movies.description: An aspiring bodybuilder named Killian Maddox becomes consumed by his dream of achieving recognition in professional bodybuilding, while struggling with isolation and the challenges of forming human connections.

movies.title: Avatar
movies.description: A paraplegic former Marine named Jake Sully is sent to the moon Pandora, where he becomes part of the Na'vi people through an artificial avatar. As he grows closer to Neytiri and her people, he must choose between following his mission and protecting their world.

movies.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
movies.description: Jake Sully and Neytiri's family face new challenges on Pandora as they encounter the Ash People, a fierce Na'vi clan led by the powerful Varang. A new conflict threatens the future of Pandora.

movies.title: Avatar: The Way of Water
movies.description: More than a decade after the events of the first film, Jake Sully and Neytiri have built a family on Pandora. When a familiar threat returns, they seek refuge with the ocean-dwelling Metkayina clan and discover a new way of life.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.description: Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man in a world that has forgotten him. As he struggles with his new life, a mysterious threat emerges that could change him forever.

movies.title: A Bug's Life
movies.description: Flik, an inventive ant, accidentally ruins his colony's annual offering to a group of bullying grasshoppers. To save his home, he sets out to find warriors but mistakenly recruits a troupe of circus bugs.

movies.title: A Charlie Brown Christmas
movies.description: Charlie Brown feels unhappy with the commercialism surrounding Christmas. With help from his friends, he attempts to discover the true meaning of the holiday by directing the school Christmas play.

movies.title: A Goofy Movie
movies.description: Goofy takes his teenage son Max on a cross-country fishing trip in hopes of bonding with him. However, Max has other plans, and their journey quickly turns into a series of hilarious adventures.

movies.title: Animal Farm
movies.description: After the animals overthrow their human farmer, they attempt to build a society based on equality. However, the pigs gradually seize power and become just as oppressive as the humans they replaced.

movies.title: Animal Farm
movies.description: After the animals overthrow their human farmer, they attempt to establish an equal society. But as the pigs take control, the farm descends into corruption and dictatorship.
